research:
Research notes on the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC), percent change from the Aug 28, 2026 close to the Sep 9, 2026 close.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo Finance ^IXIC is the resolution source. Both fetch attempts (quote page and history page) were refused by the proxy, so I could not read it directly. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EIXIC/)
- 2026-08-28: Two secondary sources put the base close at **26,402.42**. CNBC has it down 0.52% on the day. AP has it down 138.93 points, about 0.5%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/27/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [WTOP/AP](https://wtop.com/national/2026/08/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-friday-8-28-2026/)
- The Nasdaq index history page and FRED NASDAQCOM can be used as cross-checks. [Nasdaq](https://indexes.nasdaqomx.com/Index/History/COMP), [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/NASDAQCOM)
- At the 1.0 mark the target is about 26,666 (+1%). At the -1.0 mark it is about 26,138 (-1%).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. As of the Aug 30 cutoff no trading has happened in the window.
- The window has 7 trading days: Aug 31, Sep 1, 2, 3, 4, 8 and 9. Markets are closed Monday Sep 7 for Labor Day.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-28: The Nasdaq fell 0.52% to 26,402.42, the S&P 500 fell 0.25% to 7,711.76 and the Dow slipped 0.02% to 53,559.99. Nvidia dropped more than 3% after its post-earnings rally and chip stocks weighed on the index. For the week the Nasdaq rose about 0.9% and the S&P 500 about 0.5%. [Yahoo/Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-news-aug-28-133400922.html), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/08/61441583/stock-market-today-nvidia-jitters-drag-nasdaq-hot-pce-rate-hike-bets)
- 2026-08-28: In his first Jackson Hole speech as Fed Chair, Kevin Warsh was hawkish: "While this summer's readings were better than expected, they do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved." He did not commit to a September hike. [InvestmentNews](https://www.investmentnews.com/equities/no-fed-relief-at-jackson-hole-warsh-keeps-rate-hike-door-open/267991), [MPA](https://www.mpamag.com/us/mortgage-industry/industry-trends/are-rate-hikes-ahead-warsh-underlines-inflation-concern/587894)
- 2026-08-28/29: After the speech, CME FedWatch odds of a September 25bp **hike** rose from about 35-40% to about 55-60%. The policy rate is 3.50-3.75%. The July FOMC held rates in a 9-3 vote, with three dissents in favor of a hike. [Bond Buyer](https://www.bondbuyer.com/news/markets-see-rate-hike-coming-following-warshs-speech), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/warsh-turns-hawkish-at-jackson-hole-will-the-fed-hike-in-september-after-stocks-and-bitcoin-slip)
- 2026-08-27: Nvidia rose nearly 9% after earnings. [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-august-26-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-081834782.html)
- 2026-08-26: July PCE rose 0.2% m/m. Headline was 3.7% y/y against 3.6% expected, and core was 3.3% y/y. Coverage split on tone: Benzinga called it "hot", Bloomberg called it muted. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-26/us-stock-futures-tread-water-after-inflation-gauge-s-muted-rise), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/08/61441583/stock-market-today-nvidia-jitters-drag-nasdaq-hot-pce-rate-hike-bets)
- Early to mid August: Hopes for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz lifted stocks around Aug 4-5, when the Nasdaq closed at 26,584.99, up 2.6% on Aug 4, and sat about 2% below its record. Those hopes faded by Aug 10. Oil had reached $102 at the peak of the conflict. [Local10/AP](https://www.local10.com/news/2026/08/05/stocks-waver-on-wall-street-and-hover-around-records-as-oil-prices-hold-steady/), [Virginia Business](https://virginiabusiness.com/nasdaq-falls-hormuz-deal-fade-oil-prices/)
- I could not confirm the current record high or the year-to-date change.

## 4. Base rates
- These figures are my own estimates, not taken from a source.
- **Typical range:** Over 7 trading days the Nasdaq usually moves by about 2.5-3.5% (one standard deviation), based on its usual daily volatility of roughly 1-1.3%. About two-thirds of comparable windows end within ±3%, and moves beyond ±6% are rare. They tend to happen in sell-offs, such as the April 2025 tariff shock.
- **Average drift:** The average gain over a window this long is small, roughly +0.3%.
- **September seasonality:** September has historically been the Nasdaq's weakest month on average, and the first half of September is often soft. The effect is weak compared with normal week-to-week swings.
- **Recent context:** The index moves fast. It rose 2.6% in a single day on Aug 4, and it gained 0.9% in the week to Aug 28.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the Nasdaq's level or percent change for this window.
- On the related Fed question, after Jackson Hole Kalshi priced about a 48% chance of a September hike and Polymarket about 49%. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/warsh-turns-hawkish-at-jackson-hole-will-the-fed-hike-in-september-after-stocks-and-bitcoin-slip)
- Weekly outlooks written before Aug 31 leaned bearish. A Moomoo community post was titled "The second leg of the US stock decline may begin", and others named the jobs report and Iran/oil as the main drivers. These are low-quality sources. [Moomoo](https://www.moomoo.com/community/feed/weekly-forecast-august-31-september-4-2026-the-second-leg-117184491356166), [StockCram](https://www.stockcram.com/analysis/week-ahead-2026-08-30)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Week of Aug 31:** The economic calendar is sparse apart from Fed speakers. Oil (around $83-88 per StockCram) and Iran/Hormuz headlines are a risk factor. [StockCram](https://www.stockcram.com/analysis/week-ahead-2026-08-30)
- **About Sep 2-3:** Broadcom fiscal Q3 earnings, which matter for AI and semiconductor sentiment. The date is estimated, not confirmed. [TheRightTrader](https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/avgo)
- **Fri Sep 4:** August jobs report, the main macro event for September hike odds.
- **Mon Sep 7:** Market holiday (Labor Day).
- **About Sep 8-10:** Oracle fiscal Q1 earnings, possibly after the Sep 9 close. The date is not confirmed.
- **After resolution:** August CPI is likely around Sep 10-11, and the FOMC meets Sep 15-16 (one source says Sep 16-17). Positioning ahead of both could affect Sep 8-9.
